reviewer: Root assistant, independent of fresh executor agents

projection.note: The fountain is top/front readable, but the base depth is foreshortened rather than occupying the screen-aligned 256x256 ground rectangle.

complete-art.note: Inspected complete source and normalized placement/cutout/repeat output; recorded operations preserve the declared frame and source art.

anchor-placement.note: The stone foundation lies above and inside the declared 2x2 ground boundaries; a correct stored center is not proof that its base lands there.

multi-cell-size.note: Actual base does not fill the 256x256 ground footprint shown in the independent placement preview; it was not resized or refitted.

multi-cell-overlap.note: Whole art survives, but neighbor previews cannot establish correct occupancy/overlap because base placement and depth drift.

source-faithfulness.note: Inspected complete source and normalized placement/cutout/repeat output; recorded operations preserve the declared frame and source art.

limitations: One fresh attempt per case does not estimate reliability.
Landmark/perspective judgments are approximate; no AI geometric exactness is claimed.
inspection: Original generated art, actual light/dark cutouts, registration placement and repeated terrain images inspected.
